query:
SELECT l.pubkey, l.slot, l.lamports, l.closed_at_slot, l.listing_id, l.developer,
               l.asset_id, l.share_price, l.listed_share_amount, l.sold_share_amount,
               l.reserved_share_amount, l.tax_paid_by_developer, l.tax_bps,
               l.marketplace_fee_bps, l.investor_fee_bps, l.max_ownership_bps,
               l.listing_expiry, l.claiming_time, l.claim_deadline, l.legal_process_time,
               l.lawyer_voting_time, l.min_voting_quorum_bps, l.position_count,
               l.legal_deadline, l.deposit, l.developer_lawyer, l.developer_lawyer_costs,
               l.developer_lawyer_doc_status, l.developer_lawyer_documents_hash, l.spv_lawyer,
               l.spv_lawyer_costs, l.spv_lawyer_doc_status, l.spv_lawyer_documents_hash,
               l.second_attempt, l.developer_engaged, l.spv_costs_due, l.spv_costs_payee,
               l.collected_fee_quote, l.collected, l.spv_election_expiry,
               l.spv_election_candidate_count, l.spv_election_round, l.status,
               pa.pubkey AS "pa_pubkey?", pa.slot AS "pa_slot?",
               pa.lamports AS "pa_lamports?",
               pa.closed_at_slot AS "pa_closed_at_slot?",
               pa.asset_id AS "pa_asset_id?",
               pa.name AS "pa_name?",
               pa.metadata_uri AS "pa_metadata_uri?",
               pa.share_mint AS "pa_share_mint?",
               pa.region_id AS "pa_region_id?",
               pa.location AS "pa_location?",
               pa.share_amount AS "pa_share_amount?",
               pa.spv_created AS "pa_spv_created?",
               pa.finalized AS "pa_finalized?",
               pa.holder_count AS "pa_holder_count?"
        FROM marketplace_listing AS l
        LEFT JOIN marketplace_property_asset AS pa ON pa.asset_id = l.asset_id
        -- ADR-43 (index support ADR-44): the `assignableTo` vacancy feed orders by
        -- SOLD-OUT recency — the durable sold-out record's coordinate slot (0018), not the
        -- listing's own mirror slot. One row per listing in `sold_out_notifications`, so
        -- the join never multiplies rows, and 0019's listing index backs the probe.
        LEFT JOIN sold_out_notifications AS sn ON sn.listing_id = l.listing_id
        WHERE ($1::bigint IS NULL OR l.listing_id = $1)
          AND ($2::bytea IS NULL OR l.developer = $2)
          AND ($3::text IS NULL OR l.status = $3)
          AND ($4::bool IS NULL OR (l.closed_at_slot IS NULL) = $4)
          -- ADR-39, one arm per feed state (see ListingFeedState's doc for the partition):
          -- the sale phase is LISTED with shares available, split by the wall clock; the
          -- claim phase is LISTED fully committed (claims run under LISTED on chain);
          -- SOLD_OUT/LEGAL are the sold-out legal/settlement phase.
          AND ($7::text[] IS NULL OR (
                 ('FOR_SALE' = ANY($7) AND l.status = 'LISTED'
                      AND l.listing_expiry > $8
                      AND (l.listed_share_amount - l.sold_share_amount - l.reserved_share_amount) > 0)
              OR ('WAITING_FOR_CLAIM' = ANY($7) AND l.status = 'LISTED'
                      AND (l.listed_share_amount - l.sold_share_amount - l.reserved_share_amount) = 0
                      AND (l.claim_deadline = 0 OR l.claim_deadline > $8))
              OR ('SOLD_OUT' = ANY($7) AND l.status IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'LEGAL'))
              OR ('EXPIRED' = ANY($7) AND (l.status = 'EXPIRED'
                      OR (l.status = 'LISTED'
                          AND (l.listed_share_amount - l.sold_share_amount - l.reserved_share_amount) > 0
                          AND l.listing_expiry <= $8)
                      OR (l.status = 'LISTED'
                          AND (l.listed_share_amount - l.sold_share_amount - l.reserved_share_amount) = 0
                          AND l.claim_deadline > 0 AND l.claim_deadline <= $8)))
              OR ('FINALIZED' = ANY($7) AND l.status = 'FINALIZED')
              OR ('CANCELLED_OR_REFUNDING' = ANY($7) AND l.status IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDING'))))
          AND ($9::text[] IS NULL OR l.status = ANY($9))
          -- ADR-43: `assignedLawyer` — the lawyer sits in EITHER seat ("Under Instruction").
          AND ($10::bytea IS NULL OR (l.developer_lawyer = $10 OR l.spv_lawyer = $10))
          -- ADR-45 (refining ADR-43/44): `assignableTo` — the vacancy feed ("Newly
          -- listed"): live listings — LISTED, or SOLD_OUT with the legal window still
          -- open (0 = unset, same bound wall clock as feedStates) — whose SPV exists
          -- (`property_asset.spv_created`, the `claim_spv_case` gate behind the on-chain
          -- `SpvNotCreated` rejection) and whose SPV-lawyer seat is still VACANT (the
          -- all-zero sentinel $12). Only the SPV can take the SPV seat, so SPV vacancy is
          -- the self-claimable job; the developer seat is filled by the developer's
          -- `assign_developer_lawyer`, so either-seat vacancy (ADR-44) over-included
          -- non-claimable rows. The two not-the-asking-lawyer exclusions stay — the
          -- developer-seat one mirrors the chain's `ConflictOfInterest` rejection, the
          -- SPV-seat one keeps the degenerate asking==sentinel case empty. Terminal/
          -- settled statuses (LEGAL, FINALIZED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, REFUNDING) and
          -- PENDING_ASSETS stay excluded by the status list. The EXISTS probes the asset
          -- over its indexed `asset_id`, byte-identically in both statements.
          AND ($11::bytea IS NULL OR (
                 l.status IN ('LISTED', 'SOLD_OUT')
                 AND (l.legal_deadline = 0 OR l.legal_deadline > $8)
                 AND l.spv_lawyer = $12
                 AND l.developer_lawyer <> $11
                 AND l.spv_lawyer <> $11
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_property_asset AS spa
                              WHERE spa.asset_id = l.asset_id
                                AND spa.spv_created)))
        -- ADR-43 (with ADR-44's LISTED rows joining the NULLS-LAST group): with
        -- `assignableTo`, sold-out recency (notification slot DESC, everything with no
        -- recorded sold-out — including every live LISTED row — last, by listing slot);
        -- otherwise the CASE is all-NULL and the default ordering stands.
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN $11::bytea IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE sn.slot END DESC NULLS LAST,
                 l.slot DESC, l.pubkey ASC
        LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6
